LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Nat. c.]
Tearing and bruised pain in right hip. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Jerkings in lower extremities and in parts of lower body.
Unsteadiness while walking, stumbling, slipping.
Lower extremities feel very heavy and bruised.
Heaviness of legs and feet, with tension in them while sitting or walking.
Creeping, stinging in muscles of thighs and beneath epigastrium.
Blotches (as in lepra) on legs.
Hollow of knee painful on motion.
Tension in bend of knee ; muscles shortened.
Cramp of calves.
When walking in open air sensation as if a knife pierced calf of leg and as though blood trickled down it.
Lower legs swollen, inflamed, red and covered with ulcers.
Easy dislocation and spraining of ankle ; ankle is so weak that it gives way ; foot bends under.
Cutting pain and cramps in feet.
Very cold feet.
Burning in feet, especially soles, while walking.
Swelling of feet and soles of feet, with stinging in them when walking or stepping on them.
Soreness of feet, particularly of soles.
Stitches as with needles in sole of right foot ; sole swollen.
Throbbing and crawling in heels.
Ulcer on heel from spreading blisters.
Black, ulcerated pustules on heel.
Blisters on points of toes, as if scalded.
Smarting and soreness between toes ; excoriation.
Swelling, tearing and soreness in (big) toes, no sleep.
Red spot on big toe, as if contused.
Violent stitches in a corn.
Boring, drawing and stinging in corns.
Cold feet.
Pressing pain in dorsa of feet.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Nat. c.]
Great weakness of lower extremities and heaviness of arms.
Cutting pains in hands and feet.
Vesicular places of tips of all fingers and toes, as if scalded, extending around nails as if they would come off.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Nat. c.]
Rest : vertigo < ; dulness of head.
Lying : on left side, palpitation ; stitch in back to anus.
Must lie down : weariness.
Sitting : backache, heaviness < ; stitch in back to anus.
Sewing : pain in right rhomboid muscle.
Most symptoms appear while sitting and go off on motion, pressing and rubbing.
Moving : backache and heaviness > ; of head, cracking of cervical vertebræ ; hollow of knee painful ; causes profuse sweat.
Suddenly turning head : frontal headache.
On taking hold of anything : twitches in arms and fingers.
Has to stretch arms : with anxiety.
When ascending : anxious palpitation.
On stepping : foot bends.
Walking : violent backache ; unsteadiness ; heaviness of legs and feet with tension ; as if knife pierced calf of leg ; burning in feet ; swelling of feet with stinging.
Exercising : pain in right rhomboid muscle ; causes great debility.
   

NERVES. [36] [Nat. c.]
Great debility from any exertion ; unsteady walk, any little obstruction on pavement causes him to fall, or falls without apparent cause.
Is ready to drop after a short walk.
Exhaustion from mental effort.
Great prostration and heaviness of whole body.
Great lassitude and vertigo from effects of exposure to sun.
Uneasiness.
Twitching in muscles and limbs.
Contractions of muscles, hands, bends of knees, neck, etc.
Hysteria.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Nat. c.]
Sleepiness : during day, with yawning.
Falls asleep late at night.
Awakes too early in morning.
During sleep : starts, twitches ; vivid dreams, violent erections and sexual excitement ; restless, with ebullitions, palpitation and nightmare.
Dreams : anxious ; confused ; pleasant ; amorous.
   

TIME. [38] [Nat. c.]
Morning : dulness in occiput ; agglutination of eyes ; mucus hawked up ; violent retching ; distended abdomen ; trembling of hands ; sleepiness ; awakes too early ; shivering for one hour ; sudden chilliness not followed by heat ; bloating of whole body.
About 10 or 11 A. M. : weak feeling in stomach.
During forenoon : lachrymation ; ravenous hunger ; chilliness <.
During day : coryza ; sleepiness ; feeling of coldness in lower extremities ; cold and chilly.
Noon : headache.
Afternoon : thirst ; frequent eructations ; swelling of hands ; bloating of whole body <.
After dinner : needle-like stitches in both eyes.
Evening : restlessness of body ; headache in forehead with nausea, eructations and dimness of sight ; stitch in back.
Night : flashes and streaks of light before closed eyes ; coryza < ; mucus collects in throat ; bruised pain over back ; palpitation ; pulse excited ; stitch in back ; falls asleep late.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Nat. c.]
Sequela of exposure to heat of sun ; inability to think ; head feels stupefied and aches when in sun ; dazzling flashes or black spots before eyes ; dimness of sight ; palpitation ; trembling of hands ; debility from least exertion ; restless, unrefreshing sleep ; profuse sweat from least exertion.
Great debility caused by heat of summer.
Chronic effects of sunstroke ; may have been overcome by heat years ago, and now, with return of hot weather, suffers from headaches.
Open air : exercise, vertigo > ; rigidity and drawing between scapulæ ; when walking, as if knife pierced calf of leg.
In room : headache < ; cough <.
In sun : vertigo ; dulness in head ; exposure to, causes vertigo and great lassitude.
Draft of air : coryza <.
Averse to uncovering.
Damp weather : pain in right rhomboid muscle.
Change of clothing : coryza <.
After getting a thorough wetting : skin perfectly dry, formerly perspired easily, and chronic coryza.
Cold water : great thirst for it, but < after drinking it ; stitches in left hypochondrium.
Bad effects of a cold drink while overheated.
   

FEVER. [40] [Nat. c.]
Chilliness and shivering for one hour in morning.
Sudden chilliness, not followed by heat in morning.
Feeling of coldness in lower extremities even during day.
Continued chill in left side.
Cold hands and feet, with hot head.
Cold and chilly all day, < in forenoon ; hands and feet cold, head hot, or hands and feet hot, with cold cheeks.
Evening chilliness, dulness of head ; then heat and sleep.
Heat, with general sweat.
Flushes of heat from (nose) down back ; irritability ; averse to uncovering.
Heat of face.
Sweat profuse from every exertion ; anxiety.
Burning sweat on forehead where hat presses.
Night sweat, alternating with dry skin.
Morning sweat.
Cold, anxious sweat.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Nat. c.]
At certain hours of day : tearing pain in forehead returns.
Alternately : ineffectual urgings and liquid stools ; constipation and liquid stools ; night sweat and dry skin.
Alternate days : coryza <.
Worse during full moon.
Every morning : pulsating headache in vertex.
Every night : troublesome stoppage of nose ; pressing toothache ; involuntary micturition.
Before menses : chronic otitis media.
For seven or eight months : loss of hearing in right ear.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Nat. c.]
Right : drawing and tension in right side of occiput ; long continued pressure in side of occiput ; loss of hearing ; singing in ear ; fulness in ear ; as if something moved in ear ; violent sharp stitches in hypochondriac region ; pain in leg ; burning soreness in chest ; pain in rhomboid muscle ; hard swelling on upper part of gland ; tearing and bruised pain in hip.
Left : shooting pain in frontal eminence to lower occiput ; sounds seem to come from left side when they really come from right ; roaring in ear ; caries of molar teeth ; pain in side of face ; stiffness of shoulder ; stitches in hypochondrium ; boring from tip of scapula ; chilliness in side of thorax ; stitch in back as far as side ; stitches in sole of foot ; chill in side.
Particularly upper right, lower left side.
From within outward : stitches in eyes.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Nat. c.]
Head as if too large ; as if forehead would burst ; as if head would be drawn back ; as of feathers before eyes ; as if ears were closed up ; as of a bubble bursting in ear ; on swallowing, feeling as if something moved in right ear ; as if tip of tongue was cracked ; dryness of mouth as if caused by heat of breath ; swellings as if from incarcerated wind ; as if veins of right leg were bruised ; pressure in hypogastrium as if everything would come out ; as if uterus would protrude ; motion as from a fetus in uterus ; as if a knife pierced calf of leg and as though blood trickled down it ; stitches as of needles in sole of right foot ; blisters on points of toes, as if scalded ; red spot on big toe as if contused ; as if nails would come off ; itching as from fleas.
Pain : in forehead ; in left frontal eminence to lower occiput ; from occiput to vertex ; in left side of face ; in small of back and left leg ; in bones of face ; in stomach ; in rectum ; in right rhomboid muscle ; in back.
Stupefying pain : in forehead.
Stitching, tearing, throbbing : in forehead, temples, vertex.
Tearing pain : in forehead ; in right hip ; in big toes.
Shooting pain : in left frontal eminence to left lower occiput ; in vesicles.
Violent sharp stitches : in right hypochondriac region ; in region of spleen ; in a corn.
Sharp piercing stitches : in ears.
Needle-like stitches : in both eyes.
Pressing stitches : in chest.
Stitches : in head and out of eyes ; in left hypochondrium ; in hepatic and splenic region ; in back ; in small of back ; in sole of right foot.
Cutting : in stomach ; in anus ; in rectum ; in hands ; in feet.
Pulsating pain : in vertex.
Digging, boring : toothache.
Boring : from tip of left scapula.
Boring, drawing stinging : in corns.
Stinging : in eye.
Pressing, drawing, cutting : in stomach.
Griping : in stomach ; in lower abdomen.
Writhing : about umbilicus.
Cramp : in stomach ; of calves ; in feet.
Rheumatic pain : of shoulder, arms and elbows.
Pressing pain : in forehead ; in teeth ; in goitre ; in stomach ; on shoulders ; in dorsa of feet.
Drawing pain : from occiput to nape ; in stomach ; in elbow.
Bruised pain : over back ; in right hip.
Smarting : between toes.
Burning soreness : in right mid chest.
Burning : about tip of tongue ; of blisters in mouth ; of eyes and urethra ; in anus ; in rectum ; along spine ; in feet.
Soreness : of mouth ; in stomach ; between scrotum and thighs ; of feet, < soles ; between toes ; in big toes.
Stinging : in feet.
Creeping, stinging : in muscles of thighs and beneath epigastrium.
Throbbing and crawling : in heels.
Tingling : in back.
Painful cracking : in region of heart.
Painful sense of emptiness : in occiput.
Burning heat : of face.
Bruised, heavy feeling : in lower extremities.
Drawing : in right side of occiput ; in testicles ; in nape of neck.
Violent pressure : in stomach.
Long continued pressure : in right side of occiput.
Dull pressure : from occiput to nape ; in stomach ; in region of bladder ; in hypogastrium.
Tension : in head ; in right side of occiput ; in nape ; in legs and feet ; in bend of knees.
Heaviness : of upper lids ; of tongue ; in stomach ; in testicles ; of legs and feet ; of arms ; of whole body.
Fulness : in right ear.
Constriction : around stomach.
Stiffness : of neck and left shoulder.
Obstruction : in head.
Dryness : of mouth and lips ; of throat.
Squeaking sensation : at root of nose.
Voluptuous sensation : in genitals.
Gone, weak feeling : in stomach.
Twitching sensation : in arms and fingers.
Jerking : in finger joints ; in lower extremities and in parts of lower body.
Itching : in anus ; over whole body ; in vesicles.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Nat. c.]
Emaciation, with pale face, dilated pupils ; dark urine.
Bloating of whole body mornings, > in afternoon.
Pallid anemia, with great debility, with watery or milky whiteness of skin, when disease is due to an original inertia and phlegmatic state.
Putrid leucorrhœa, uterine troubles ; vitality below par.
Subacute, inflammatory irritation of whole alimentary mucous membrane, from mouth to anus.
Swelling and induration of glands ; scrofulosis.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Nat. c.]
Generally > from touch, pressing or rubbing parts gently.
Cutting pain, burning and stinging in wounded parts.
Touch : peeling off of dorsum and tip of nose painful ; ulcers and blisters painful ; soreness in stomach < ; pit of stomach sensitive ; warts on arms and backs of hands.
Desire to be rubbed : during labor pains.
Where hat presses : burning sweat on forehead.
Easily sprained ; disposition to be sprained by any exertion ; old sprains.
   

SKIN. [46] [Nat. c.]
Itching over whole body as from fleas.
Sensation of formication.
Skin of whole body becomes dry, rough and cracked in places.
Red vesicles filled with fluid in bend of elbow, in fold between genitals and thigh and on chin.
Vesicles, with shooting pains and itching.
Spreading and suppurating herpes.
Herpes : iris ; circinatus ; suppurating.
Yellow rings like remains of herpes.
Itch-like eruption on lower part of abdomen.
Light brown spots (freckles) on face.
Warts : ulcerate ; sensitive to touch.
Ulcers, with swelling and inflammatory redness of affected parts ; burning, pricking and pulsating ; pus corroding, acrid, putrid and yellow.
Rose colored blotches in leprous patients.
Spots and tubercles all over face, arms, thighs and legs, which ulcerate ; leprosy.
Elephantiasis græcorum.
Amelioration by gently pressing parts or rubbing.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Nat. c.]
Leuco-phlegmatic constitutions, with aversion to open air and dislike to exercise, physical or mental.
Boy, æt. 15 ; goitre.
Girl, æt. 16, lymphatic habit ; coryza.
Man, æt. 27, private secretary ; goitre.
Woman, æt. 40, large, leuco-phlegmatic ; affection of chest.
Woman, music teacher, suffering from chronic coryza, after getting wet ; suppression of sweat.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Nat. c.]
Antidoted by : Camphor, Spir. nitr. dul.
It antidotes : Cinchona.
Compatible : Calc. ostr., Nux. vom., Pulsat., Sepia, Sulphur.
Compare : Natr. sulph., which is preferable for yeast-like vomiting, with pallid, dirty and broad tongue ; Arsen., Carbo veg., Lycop., Mercur., Natr. mur., Phosphor., Silic.
